Flask: CSP nonce, security headers and cache headers (after_request)
recipes.snippet:
Flask 3.1, no extra package. Hand-rolled on purpose: flask-talisman has had no release since 2023-08 (v1.1.0). One fresh nonce per response, created lazily so it also exists on 404/500 pages. Flask has no asset fingerprinting: use your bundler's hashed output names (app/static/dist/app.3f2a9c1b.js). If nginx or a CDN serves /static, set the same Cache-Control for hashed files there. This CSP blocks inline style="..." attributes: use classes.
### file: app/security.py
import base64
import re
import secrets

from flask import Flask, g, request

# SEC-010 / SEC-075: nonce + 'strict-dynamic', no 'unsafe-inline', frame-ancestors, object-src/base-uri closed.
CSP = (
    "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'; "
    "style-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; "
    "object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; "
    "upgrade-insecure-requests"
)
HASHED = re.compile(r"[.-][a-f0-9]{8,}\.")  # PRF-008: fingerprinted file names


def nonce() -> str:
    if "csp_nonce" not in g:
        g.csp_nonce = base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(16)).decode("ascii")
    return g.csp_nonce


def init_security(app: Flask) -> None:
    @app.context_processor
    def inject_nonce():
        return {"csp_nonce": nonce()}  # templates: <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}" src="...">

    @app.after_request  # also runs for responses produced by error handlers
    def set_headers(resp):
        h = resp.headers
        h.setdefault("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
        h.setdefault("Referrer-Policy", "strict-origin-when-cross-origin")
        h.setdefault("Permissions-Policy", "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()")
        if request.is_secure:  # behind a proxy wrap app.wsgi_app in werkzeug ProxyFix so this is true
            h.setdefault("Strict-Transport-Security", "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains")
        if resp.mimetype == "text/html":
            h["Content-Security-Policy"] = CSP.format(nonce=nonce())
            # PRF-008: HTML always revalidates. no-cache is also safe for pages that set a cookie (SEC-016).
            # A view that wants a CDN lifetime sets its own Cache-Control and must not set cookies.
            h.setdefault("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
        elif request.endpoint == "static" and HASHED.search(request.path) and resp.status_code == 200:
            h["Cache-Control"] = "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"  # PRF-008
        return resp
### file: app/__init__.py
from flask import Flask

from .security import init_security


def create_app() -> Flask:
    app = Flask(__name__)
    init_security(app)
    return app
### file: app/templates/base.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>{% block title %}Site{% endblock %}</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{{ url_for('static', filename='dist/app.3f2a9c1b.css') }}">
  {% block head %}{% endblock %}
</head>
<body>
  {% block content %}{% endblock %}
  <script nonce="{{ csp_nonce }}" src="{{ url_for('static', filename='dist/app.3f2a9c1b.js') }}" defer></script>
</body>
</html>

recipes.title: Flask: /api/health with a database check (Flask-SQLAlchemy)
recipes.snippet:
Flask 3.1 + Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.x (`db = SQLAlchemy()` created in app/extensions.py, `db.init_app(app)` and `app.config.from_object("app.config")` in create_app). Register with app.register_blueprint(health_bp). No database in the project: replace the SELECT 1 with a call to your critical dependency and keep the try/except shape. The body is a fixed literal: no versions, no engine names, never the exception text.
### file: app/health.py
from flask import Blueprint, current_app, jsonify
from sqlalchemy import text

from .extensions import db

health_bp = Blueprint("health", __name__)


@health_bp.get("/api/health")
def health():
    try:
        db.session.execute(text("SELECT 1"))  # OPS-002: process AND database reachable
        resp = jsonify(status="ok")
    except Exception as exc:
        db.session.rollback()
        current_app.logger.error("health check failed: %s", type(exc).__name__)  # log only, never in the body
        resp = jsonify(status="unavailable")
        resp.status_code = 503
    resp.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    return resp
### file: app/config.py
import os

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]
# ~2s ceiling so a dead database turns into 503 quickly (PostgreSQL driver option; other drivers name it differently).
SQLALCHEMY_ENGINE_OPTIONS = {"pool_timeout": 2, "pool_pre_ping": True, "connect_args": {"connect_timeout": 2}}
